# Reception Perception: The Show — 2024-01-16

**Raw transcript:** `raw/ingested/reception-perception/2024-01-16-rp-wild-card-weekend-recap.md` (immutable — do not edit)

## Summary

The first Reception Perception episode ingested into this wiki. Hosted by
[[Matt Harmon]] with co-host **James Koh** (not a tracked expert; ASR renders
his name as "James Go"/"James Gov"/"James Coe" throughout — normalized
here). A game-recap show, not primarily a fantasy show ("we don't talk about
fantasy a lot on this show," Harmon says explicitly), but with plenty of
fantasy-relevant player evaluation woven through the recap of all four 2023
NFL Wild Card games:

- **Cowboys 32, Packers 48 (Dallas blown out at home):** extended praise for
  [[Jordan Love]] and Matt LaFleur; a look around Green Bay's deep receiver
  room ([[Jayden Reed]], [[Dontayvion Wicks]], [[Romeo Doubs]],
  [[Christian Watson]]); [[CeeDee Lamb]] and [[Dak Prescott]] downgraded for
  the loss, with a long coaching-carousel tangent (Bill Belichick, Mike
  Vrabel, Deion Sanders) **not ingested** as wiki content — no fantasy-relevant
  player claim was at stake.
- **Dolphins 26, Chiefs 7:** the harshest [[Tua Tagovailoa]] read logged in
  this wiki so far, benchmarked directly against [[Jared Goff]] (new page);
  [[Rashee Rice]]'s role continues to look "perfectly nailed."
- **Texans 45, Browns 14:** [[C.J. Stroud]] and [[Nico Collins]] both get a
  strong evaluative bump; [[Joe Flacco]]'s Cleveland run gets an
  end-of-runway framing, with Deshaun Watson's contract situation discussed
  mostly as team-building speculation, not a player evaluation — logged only
  briefly on Flacco's own page.
- **Rams 24, Lions 23:** [[Puka Nacua]] sets an NFL rookie playoff-yardage
  record and gets unqualified superstar framing; [[Cooper Kupp]]'s decline
  gets its most explicit treatment yet, directly citing Reception
  Perception's own man-coverage separation charting.

This episode also introduces the [[Reception Perception Methodology]] concept
page — Harmon's WR charting project and, by reference, colleague Derrick
Klassen's related quarterback-pressure charting (both published at
ReceptionPerception.com; Klassen is not Harmon and not a tracked expert).

**Not given pages** (mentioned, no substantive standalone evaluative take):
Deshaun Watson (trade/contract speculation only), Amon-Ra St. Brown (single
play description), Travis Kelce (one-line drop mention, already covered
elsewhere on his page), Bobby Slowik and other coaches (not players).
